description_en: Modifies the configuration of fine-grained monitoring in a specified region
description_zh: 修改高精度秒级监控的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun slb modify-high-defination-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project my-project --log-store my-log-store --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHighDefinationMonitor

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the project of Log Service. The name must be 4 to 63 characters in length, and can contain digits and lowercase letters. It must start and end with a digit or a letter
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的日志服务LogProject的名称。日志服务LogProject的名称。长度为4~63个字符，支持数字、小写字母，可包含短划线（-），开头和结尾必须为数字或字母
parameters.name: log_project

parameters.help_en: The new name of the Logstore of Log Service. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain digits, lowercase letters, hyphens (-) and underscores (_). It must start and end with a digit or a letter
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的日志服务LogStore的名称。长度为2~64个字符，支持数字、小写字母，可包含短划线（-）和下划线（_），开头和结尾必须为数字或字母
parameters.name: log_store

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
Success.description_zh:
本次调用是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败
